package fixture

import "github.com/rbenzing/minutiae/internal/evidence"

// This file is data for TestRecoveredKindsScannerSelfTest (a .txt file: it is
// neither compiled nor scanned by the rule itself). Every line that must be
// flagged carries the marker "want"; no other line may be flagged.

const aliasKind = evidence.KindRecover

var (
	aliasLiteral = "slack"
	aliasOfAlias = aliasKind
	unrelatedName = "file"
)

func build() {
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindRecover} // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindCarve}   // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindSlack}   // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindJournal} // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindReport}  // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "recover"}            // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "carve"}              // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "slack"}              // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "journal"}            // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "report"}             // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: (evidence.KindCarve)} // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: `recover`}            // want

	var s evidence.Source
	s.Kind = evidence.KindRecover // want
	s.Kind = "carve"              // want
	other.Kind = KindJournal      // want
	a, s.Kind = 1, "slack"        // want

	// Names bound to a recovered kind anywhere in the package are folded.
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: aliasKind}     // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: aliasLiteral}  // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: aliasOfAlias}  // want
	s.Kind = aliasKind                       // want
	local := "carve"
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: local}         // want
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: unrelatedName} // harmless: bound to a live kind

	// Harmless: other kinds, a map key named like a kind, a read, a comment.
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: "file"}
	_ = evidence.Source{Kind: evidence.KindExtract}
	_ = map[string]int{"recover": 1, "carve": 2}
	_ = map[string]evidence.Source{"recover": {Kind: "file"}}
	_ = evidence.Source{Remote: "recover"}
	if s.Kind == evidence.KindRecover {
		s.Kind = "extract"
	}
	// Kind: "recover" in a comment
	label := "slack"
	_ = label
}
